verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing platform, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows only non-AI reporting: revenue-recognition data, data-warehouse export for building your own dashboards, and an event explorer. None of it documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The llms.txt probe serves docs to external LLMs and is not an in-product AI feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
